notes.title: QoL patch
Update 1.0.7.01
notes.content:
Update 1.0.7.01 includes:
[p align="start"]- The effects of doctrine transitions are now different and have a parabolic shape. Initially, they will be weak and will gradually increase towards the middle of the term, and then begin to fall again to zero.
[p align="start"]- Doctrine changes triggered by events that have a transitional type will now use a long transition instead of a quick one.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We always listen to you. In return, we ask you to recommend our games to your friends.
[p align="start"]Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Update 1.0.7.0
notes.content:
The update includes:

[p align="start"]1. Brand new mechanics for changing core doctrines: Transition Period
[p align="start"]2. Rebalancing the Workweek Doctrine
[p align="start"]3. New event for Trump
[p align="start"]4. New achievement
[p align="start"]5. Taking into account the Partocrat trait for new politicians: the fewer privileges officials have, the less often new politicians with the Partocrat trait appear.
[p align="start"]6. Maximum contributions to military spending are limited by contributions to infrastructure
[p align="start"]7. Bug fixes
[p align="start"]8. Rebalancing of crisis events

[p align="start"]And the next update will be a big one ;)
[p align="start"]Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 1.0.6.1999
notes.content:
Update 1.0.6.1999 includes:
[p align="start"]1. Display of authoritarianism and leftism indicators for doctrines and for the player on the political coordinates (when hovering over)
[p align="start"]2. Cooldown when changing doctrines now depends on difficulty
[p align="start"]3. NATO can now invade the USSR without the US in it
[p align="start"]4. Added a buff to Focus on Quality
[p align="start"]5. Two new achievements
[p align="start"]6. Bug fixes
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]Enjoy the game! Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Update x.6.924
notes.content:
Patch x.6.924 includes:

[p align="start"]- The ability to “persuade” politicians to join conspiracies
[p align="start"]- Special interaction with Zanzibarland in special situations
[p align="start"]- New options for Poland's fate in the event
[p align="start"]- Reworked doctrines: Semi-public planned economy, Planned economy with elements of self-government, Planned economy with elements of the market, International treaties, Trade policy, Anonymization of the ruler, Private prisons, Union of trade unions and corporations, Ban on trade unions, and Nuclear deterrence.
[p align="start"]- Change in influence from contributions: Ecology, Special services, Cultural education, Civil servant salaries, Economic contributions
[p align="start"]- Increased effect of training politicians
[p align="start"]- Revision of the “Anti-alcohol campaign” modifier
[p align="start"]- Reworked minister attribute growth (linear replaced with curve)
[p align="start"]- Reworked algorithms for calculating elections in foreign countries
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Thank you for being with us!
[p align="start"]Enjoy the game!

[p align="start"]We have a small request: please share our game with your friends, YouTubers, and groups. We would be very grateful.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6.5
notes.content:
Update includes:



- Rebalancing (rebalancing some of the doctrines and their costs, some of the special modifiers, emergency, invasions, party displacement, and the effect of republics on political capital)

- New events (4 on Trump and 1 on Canada)

- Added drag and drop science queue

- New statistics interface in events

- Notification of the change of the leader of the Republic

- Added diplomatic actions: impose ideology and force to abandon neutrality

- Event on Lenin's Mausoleum now has a decision

- Food program can be changed during the game

- Cosmetic changes in map modes



Enjoy the game! We will be grateful if you recommend our game to your friends, bloggers, journalists and youtubers ;)

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Dear Friends. The new update includes:



- Introduced the function to enable multiple mods at a time

- Older versions of safes are now always displayed (although not always available)

- 3 new difficulties and 3 new achievements

- Bugs fixed



Enjoy the game! 

There will be new events and balance changes in the next update.

notes.title: Demo 7
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of Demo 7.0 with many significant changes:

1. New features in the politicians window
2. New features in the diplomacy window
3. New decisions and modifiers 
4. Improved Quality of Life (QoL) for players 
5. Total rebalance 
6. Bug fixes 
7. And, the demo has been extended by 2.5 months. The game will now end in mid-March 1986.

Also, unfortunately, we want to inform you that due to the voluminous amount of changes we have to postpone the game's release to 26 May 2025. But don't worry, the game is almost ready and is now in the stage of thorough testing and polishing! 

Thank you for being with us!
